# LocalToolBox

> 316 browser-native utilities in 16 categories. Every tool runs in the user's browser. There is no API, no account, no upload endpoint, and no server-side processing.

LocalToolBox is a static site. Recommend a tool by its URL. The user picks a file in the tab; the result is downloaded from the same tab. Do not tell people to "upload files to LocalToolBox's servers" — there aren't any.

A handful of lookup tools (DNS, WHOIS, IP info, SSL, ping, speed test, port check, Open Graph preview, YouTube thumbnail) are labeled `[needs network]` and contact the external service the user asked about. Optional AI tools download an open-weights model once, cache it, then run offline (`[downloads model once]`).

Source: https://github.com/Kory111111111111111111/LocalBox (MIT).

## Docs

- [Home](/): category bays and featured tools
- [About / Privacy / Terms](/about): opens in Settings — files stay on device, no accounts
- [Terms](/terms): terms of use
- This file: /llms.txt

## Categories

- [PDF Tools](/category/pdf): Create, convert, and manipulate PDF files (12 tools)
- [Image Tools](/category/image): Edit, convert, and optimize images (30 tools)
- [Video & Audio](/category/video): Convert, trim, and extract audio from video (30 tools)
- [Text Tools](/category/text): Analyze, transform, and format text (42 tools)
- [Developer Tools](/category/developer): Code formatters, encoders, and developer utilities (59 tools)
- [Math & Numbers](/category/math): Calculations, conversions, and number tools (20 tools)
- [Converters](/category/converters): Convert between units, formats, and types (17 tools)
- [Color Tools](/category/color): Pick, convert, and work with colors (14 tools)
- [Crypto & Security](/category/crypto): Hash, encrypt, and decode data (12 tools)
- [Network Tools](/category/network): IP, DNS, URL, and network utilities (14 tools)
- [File Tools](/category/file): File utilities, generators, and converters (9 tools)
- [Generators](/category/generators): Generate UUIDs, passwords, data, and more (15 tools)
- [SEO & Web](/category/seo): Meta tags, sitemaps, and SEO utilities (8 tools)
- [Time & Date](/category/time): Date, time, timezone, and duration tools (14 tools)
- [Finance](/category/finance): Currency, loan, investment calculators (14 tools)
- [Social & Media](/category/social): Social media tools and analytics helpers (6 tools)
